hook: leak（漏）的延伸——發洩破壞後，只剩淒涼廢墟。
script: 秘密一 leak，惡棍就 sneak 進來 wreak 破壞；現場留下 bleak 廢墟與一道 streak 焦痕。你想 evoke 大家的良知，上司卻 revoke 你的權限。

members.speakLineEn: The storm wreaked havoc on coastal towns.
members.speakLineZh: 暴風雨對沿海城鎮造成浩劫。

members.senseAnchor: offering little or no hope; ; ; - J.M.Synge; providing no shelter or sustenance

related.synonyms: black, dim, bare, barren, desolate, stark
related.antonyms: white, whiten, focus, undimmed, covered, sheathed

members.speakLineEn: He tried to sneak a clause into the contract.
members.speakLineZh: 他想偷偷塞一條條款進合約。

members.senseAnchor: an unbroken series of events; a distinctive characteristic
members.speakLineEn: A losing streak can bias risk judgments.
members.speakLineZh: 連敗可能扭曲風險判斷。

members.speakLineEn: The passage evokes a sense of irreversible loss.
members.speakLineZh: 這段文字喚起一種不可逆的失落感。

members.senseAnchor: the mistake of not following suit when able to do so; fail to follow suit when able and required to do so
members.speakLineEn: The board revoked the temporary exemption.
members.speakLineZh: 董事會撤銷了臨時豁免。

related.synonyms: renege, annul, lift, countermand, reverse, repeal

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 地板叫: creak walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「地板叫」出場：creak 一上場梗就黏住——嘎吱響。

members.speakLineZh: 請「訂製牌」出場：bespoke 一上場梗就黏住——訂製的。

members.speakLineZh: 請「煙」出場：smoke 一上場梗就黏住——煙。
